name: A Threat Within

meta.next: Kobold Camp Cleanup, Eagan Peltskinner (quest), Brotherhood of Thieves

summary: In Northshire Valley, volunteers answer Stormwind's call as local defenses falter. At Northshire Abbey, Marshal McBride directs the response, and you begin serving on the threatened grounds.

sections.title: A Kingdom Stretched Thin
sections.body: Northshire Valley once gave people quiet for prayer, farming, and monastic study. Now it is Elwynn Forest's first defense against unrest at home. Few guards remain nearby, so the Stormwind Guard calls on each willing volunteer who reaches the abbey. Trouble spreads across the surrounding countryside.

sections.title: The Marshal's Call
sections.body: From Northshire Abbey, Marshal McBride directs the valley's defenses as danger grows. Bandits, vermin, and pests from below ground threaten the people nearby. You begin by clearing the ground around the abbey, where these threats press close to the valley's defenders and the place they protect.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: Marshal McBride is calling new arrivals to Northshire Valley to help defend it. You go inside Northshire Abbey and report to him.
Marshal McBride is the senior Stormwind Guard officer at Northshire Abbey. He directs the valley's defense and assigns recruits to face threats in the nearby countryside.

faq.q: Why is Stormwind recruiting volunteers instead of sending regular soldiers?
faq.answer: Stormwind's regular forces serve abroad to protect the Alliance. With heartland garrisons short of soldiers, local commanders rely on volunteers to defend their homes.

faq.q: What threats are currently plaguing Northshire Valley?
faq.answer: Kobolds infest the nearby mines and hills, while diseased or predatory pests trouble the vineyards. Brigands and outlaws also take advantage of the valley's depleted garrison.

faq.q: Where does this assignment lead next?
faq.answer: After you report to Marshal McBride, you are sent to clear kobolds from the hills, help local farmers and workers, and look into the growing presence of organized bandits.

faq.q: Why is Northshire Abbey being used as a military command post?
faq.answer: Northshire Abbey is a holy place of study and faith, but its stone walls and central position make it a practical base for the valley. With local authority under strain, the Stormwind Guard has set up its command within the abbey.

angles.text: As a human defender from Northshire, answering Marshal McBride's call is your first official pledge to protect your homeland and the Kingdom of Stormwind.
As an Alliance member, you see how duties across distant lands leave even its heartlands exposed to trouble within.
